נפש Ch. Augeri, crescere, in abundantiam erum-
pere. Ex Aphel Infinit. ad formam Talmudi-
cam לְאַפּוּשִׁי Ad multiplicandum, Job. 38.15. Alii le-
gunt לְאַפּוּשִׁי, quod & ad פּוּשׁ referri posset.

miter, concorditer, Act. 2. v. 46. Deinde ponitur
cum Affixis pronominibus, pro Ego ipse, Tu ipse-
met, ut Hebraeum אֲנָא נַפְשִׁי עֲצֵם Ego ipse נַפְשֵׁךְ Te-
ipsum, &c. Plur. נַפְשַׁת נַפְשָׁתָא, נַפְשִׁין.
